+fingerprint: sha256:6a904e95194d305a1a8413b1b985ede6b9f2a2f7905006ea85a52372b9533d2c
+---
+`pnpm verify` fails one existing test that this change cannot change, and the
+conflict is a planning gap, not an implementation gap.
+
+- `tests/no-skipped-in-src.test.ts` asserts zero case-insensitive occurrences
+  of the word `skipped` under `src/`. It is frozen: task 4 has no
+  `tests.modify: true` and does not list the test in `scope`, and rule 6 says
+  any other change to a preexisting test kills the task.
+- That test enforces a living requirement in
+  `openspec/specs/spec-lint-and-approve/spec.md`: "Zero checks report skipped,
+  and the word \"skipped\" SHALL NOT appear in `src/`." Change 149 has no delta
+  for `spec-lint-and-approve`, so the requirement still stands.
+- The task's own ports and the delta specs require exactly that word in `src/`:
+  `ValidatorOutcome` includes `'skipped'`, `readValidatorInputs` returns
+  `{ skipped: ValidatorSkipReason }`, the `validator_ran` event records outcome
+  `skipped`, and task 6 must print `Validation: skipped (<reason>)`. Every one
+  of those puts the literal in a `src/` file.
+
+The failures under `pnpm verify` are only the `no-skipped-in-src` case
+(`harness/types.ts`, `watcher/validator-inputs.ts`); all other 3,276 tests,
+both typechecks, the build, and the golden prompt tests pass. Typechecking and
+`biome check` are clean on the changed files. I did not modify the frozen test
+or any living spec.
